description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the Resource Center Statute, No. 01 of 2018 of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal framework - the "Resource Centre Statute No. 01 of 2018" for the Central Provincial Council. It outlines the legal provisions, powers, functions, and administrative structure for creating a Resource Centre, making it a statutory instrument/legislative enactment rather than focusing on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
